reviews.title: Too many advertisements!
reviews.text:
Minus a star for each bit of nonsense I just had to wade through.

1: I should not have to decline THREE offers to see when the take-out will be ready. No. That is a dark pattern to try to get me to hit an "accept" button by accident and you should be ashamed of yourselves.

2: I should be able to save my favorite locations without giving up all my information to anyone but Apple.

3: I should be able to browse menus without starting an order.

4: I should be able to see the ingredients _in the app,_ not just by going to the website. If you want me to go to your website, why do you even have a blighted app?! I have things I don't want to eat and I want to know if you've put them in something and I do NOT want to have to open Safari and risk losing the order because I took too long looking for the ingredients list.

And finally,
5: You're on the Apple App Store; make your app accept Apple Pay without a weird blank screen first.

reviews.title: App built with Zero QA
reviews.text:
This app looks to be built by a coder who never used it and had Zero QA. After constantly being redirected and forced to-refill in  previously entered information it took longer than it should have just to place a takeout order. If your app defaults the order pickup to ASAP don’t force the user to abandon checkout just to pick a time in the future that your app doesn’t even verify until the user is back in the checkout. This forces unnecessary waste in the users time! Probably one of the worst apps I have used to place a food order! 

Instead of forcing a user to navigate away from checkout, just place the important fields in the checkout or use a pop-up to make changes! This app developer obviously has. zero idea of modern e-commerce standards and flows!

reviews.title: Horrible App!
reviews.text: I have never had to work so hard to give away my money!!! This is a difficult and complicated app and if you make an error, it deletes everything and you have to re-do the whole entire page. I wanted to cancel the whole order about halfway through it, but my hubby had his heart set on a certain food item. All I can say is that the food better be extremely delicious or I can guarantee you that we will never be patrons at Applebee’s again! Do better!
